name: slug_title_case
description: Text casing and typography: URL slugs (Unicode transliterated to ASCII through NFKD, a chosen separator, cut at a word boundary), title case by style guide (Chicago 18th and 17th editions, AP, APA: minor words, hyphenated compounds, acronyms kept), sentence case keeping listed proper nouns, and smart quotes, apostrophes and dashes in English or Spanish.

catalog.source: original; The Chicago Manual of Style 18th ed. (2024) 8.160-8.162 and 17th ed. 8.159-8.161 as illustrated in the CMOS Q&A; AP Stylebook composition titles; APA Publication Manual 7th ed. 6.17; RAE Ortografía (2010) on quotation marks
